title: Reading
description: One sensor reading (ADR 0060). number: `value` in `unit`; state: `value` true or false, `state` its word (open, closed, on, off, ...); event: something happened, with an optional `detail`. Known senses and units: spec/senses.json.

value.description: number: the value; state: true or false; absent for events

state.description: state only: what the value means for this sense (open/closed, on/off, wet/dry, ...)

since.description: state only, in latest readings: when it last changed to this value

detail.description: event only: e.g. single, double or long for a button

device.description: The device that measured it, when a source has more than one (a Home Assistant entity, a Matter node)
